before: // Hold: ceiling and SS_done keep their values for all of S_RUN.
after: // Hold: ceiling and SS_done keep their values for all of S_RUN.
proposal.description: The step-window counter is cleared when the ramp hands over to S_RUN instead of in the idle/hiccup branch, so it is only re-armed after a ramp that finished.
proposal.reason: Suppose a soft start is aborted mid-window, for example S_SS to S_HICCUP on window_trip_SS and then back to S_SS. The retry keeps the partial cycle count, so its first ceiling step arrives early: max_on_counts leaves the MIN_ON_CNT floor after fewer than cycles_per_step switching cycles.

proposal.description: The edge detector's delayed PWM copy is re-armed low outside S_SS, like the rest of the ramp state, instead of always tracking pwm_sync.
proposal.reason: If the PWM is high on the last clock before S_SS and low on the first S_SS clock, the original counts that falling edge as a cycle boundary but the mutant does not. The first step window of the ramp is then one switching cycle longer, and the first widening of max_on_counts lands one PWM cycle late.

proposal.description: Each ramp step widens the ceiling by cycles_per_step counts instead of one count, mixing up the step period with the step size.
proposal.reason: In S_SS, the first step boundary moves max_on_counts from MIN_ON_CNT to MIN_ON_CNT+cycles_per_step (12 to 28 with the defaults) instead of to 13. The ramp overshoots max_on_limit and is clamped back on the next clock, so the ceiling and the timing of SS_done both differ from the one-count-per-window ramp.

proposal.description: On the step that would land on max_on_limit, only SS_done is raised and the ceiling step itself is skipped, as if signalling done replaced the last step.
proposal.reason: At the end of a normal ramp, SS_done rises but max_on_counts stays at max_on_limit-1. The supervisor then moves to S_RUN, where that ceiling is held, so pwm_mask gets a running backstop one count below the programmed max_on_limit.
